response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS cnt FROM constructors c JOIN constructorStandings cs ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality), avg_c AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM counts) SELECT counts.constructorId, counts.nationality, counts.cnt, counts.cnt - avg_c.avg_cnt AS diff FROM counts CROSS JOIN avg_c WHERE counts.cnt - avg_c.avg_cnt > 0 ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A constructor's count is the number of its rows in constructorStandings across all races and seasons, since the request does not restrict to a season.
The average is the unweighted mean of the per-constructor counts over constructors with at least one standings record, not the mean of all standings rows.
'Furthest above the average' means the largest positive signed difference, so constructors at or below the average are excluded.
Ties at the 10th position are broken arbitrarily, since the request does not specify a tie-break.
